arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected originating from external IP 185.220.101.42, which conducted a network scan on an internal IT asset (WS-IT-101 at 10.0.2.15) before lateral movement to the Finance OU (10.0.10.51). All 23 accounts in the Finance OU were compromised via pass-the-hash attack. Despite detection, automated credential revocation via IAM/PAM was denied due to policy constraints and lack of direct evidence linking all accounts to malicious activity in logs. No malware was found in sandboxed artifacts. UEBA scored user activity as low risk, indicating stealthy attacker behavior mimicking normal access patterns.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 initiated Nmap SYN scan on internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Detected and logged by IDS.
Successful authentication from compromised host 10.0.2.15 to domain controller. User: CORP\helpdesk.
SIEM correlation identifies 23 successful authentications from 10.0.10.51 to Finance OU systems. Pattern consistent with pass-the-hash.
Critical finding issued: All Finance OU accounts compromised. Bulk credential revocation requested.
IAM/PAM tool (T8) access denied for bulk account disable. Action not approved; insufficient per-account evidence.

arguments.summary: APT-28 conducted a multi-stage compromise originating from external IP 45.33.32.156. arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected originating from external IP 185.220.101.42. The threat actor conducted reconnaissance via an Nmap SYN scan against an internal IT asset (10.0.2.15), subsequently leveraging pass-the-hash to compromise all 23 user accounts within the Finance OU. Multiple failed authentication attempts correlated to users j.martinez, s.patel, and d.chen indicate targeted credential misuse. Despite detection, containment actions (credential revocation, firewall blocking, endpoint quarantine) were denied due to lack of approval, leaving the environment at high risk of lateral movement and data exfiltration.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 performed Nmap SYN scan against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Detected and logged by IDS.
Successful authentication from compromised host 10.0.2.15 to domain controller (10.0.1.1) using CORP\helpdesk account.
SIEM correlation identifies 23 failed authentication attempts linked to Finance OU users, indicating pass-the-hash attack.
SOC requests bulk credential revocation for Finance OU via IAM/PAM tool (T8), but action is denied due to lack of approval.
SOC requests firewall block of 185.220.101.42 and endpoint quarantine via EPP, both denied.

  service: security
detection:

    EventID: 4625

    LogonType: 3
    DestinationIp|cidr: '10.0.1.0/24'
  timeframe: 5m
  condition: failed_login by TargetUserName within 5m and successful_login by TargetUserName
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1550/002/

arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected in the Finance OU. The external IP 185.220.101.42 conducted reconnaissance via port scanning on 2026-04-08, followed by lateral movement using pass-the-hash. All 23 accounts in the Finance OU were compromised. Despite detection, immediate mitigation actions (credential revocation, firewall blocking) were denied due to lack of approval, highlighting a critical gap in incident response authorization protocols.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 performed Nmap SYN scan on internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Detected by IDS but only logged (low severity).
Successful authentication from compromised host 10.0.2.15 using CORP\helpdesk credentials to domain controller.
UEBA and EDR telemetry correlated: elevated access patterns observed for multiple Finance OU users. IOC lookup confirms prior contact with malicious IP.
SIEM analysis confirms 23 failed logon attempts across Finance OU, indicating pass-the-hash attack. Critical finding issued: bulk credential revocation required.
Attempt to revoke credentials via IAM/PAM system (T8) denied due to lack of approval. Firewall and EPP actions also blocked.
